svg.title: Oersted Field Families: Analytic Cylindrical Wire and Biot-Savart / Vector Potential
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure comparing (a) OerstedCylinder wire cross-section, azimuthal right-hand-rule field, and exact piecewise radial profile |H_phi(rho)|/H_peak peaking at rho = R, and (b) 3D Biot-Savart current element geometry, integral formula, and conservative RT0 closure feeding OE-F1 direct quadrature and OE-F2 H(curl) vector-potential solves.
